title: ErrorEnvelope
description: Canonical API error response envelope. Owner: platform/contracts. Provides stable error codes, human-readable messages, and structured detail for debugging without leaking internal implementation.

message.description: Human-readable error message. Must not contain secrets or stack traces.
examples: The specified tenant does not exist or you do not have access.

detail.description: Structured detail safe for client consumption. May include field-level validation errors.

examples.reason: must be a positive decimal string

request_id.description: Request correlation identifier for support and log tracing.

retryable.description: Whether the client may retry the same request without modification.
